classes.name: Vacuous evidence
classes.description: A committed trace, fixture, or test is presented as evidence for an invariant but cannot falsify it: the scenario never reaches the guarded state, or the evidence type cannot express the violation. Canonical instance: the t4 pre-existing-mother trace offered for D-8 never exercises an own-planted mother's ownership flip, so it is vacuous for the amended D-8.

origin.quote: The current t4 pre-existing mother is vacuous for D-8
add non-vacuous regression tests that fail on the rejected bytes

classes.name: Scripted trace passed off as candidate output
classes.description: A committed (transcript, commands) trace declared as candidate behavior was authored by a scripted per-turn policy, not by the candidate binary. A scripted trace cannot survive regeneration: recompiling the declared source and replaying the committed transcript yields different command lines. Canonical instance: round-3 t5, whose scripted commands convert after the flip while the real 2f58edef candidate WAITs through turn 20.

origin.quote: t5 is a scripted policy, not candidate output. Running the real candidate on the same scenario gives PICK, MOVE, PLANT, then resident WAIT through turn 20

classes.name: Mechanics-derived quantity computed in more than one place
classes.description: A quantity derived from game mechanics (conversion deadline, ETA, growth-aware chop count, cost) is computed by hand-rolled arithmetic in some artifact instead of by the single named oracle, so spec, code, tests, and detectors can disagree. Canonical instances: round-2's ceil(current_health/chop_power) ignoring growth during the chop sequence; round-3's three divergent deadlines (spec '< eta_opp', code '< max(eta_opp, predicted.cooldown)', D-8 'exact_chops < eta_opp_at_chop_start').

origin.quote: Conversion uses ceil(current_health / chop_power). This ignores health gained when a banana grows during the chop sequence, despite the same source already having exact growth-aware predict_tree/chop_outcome mechanics
These mix different deadlines and time origins ... One named oracle must drive spec, code, R-3, and D-8

classes.name: Red evidence fails the old bytes for a side reason
classes.description: A red/green regression pair whose red run on the rejected bytes exits nonzero, but whose failure mechanism does not match the documented defect: the check would stay red (or go green) for reasons unrelated to the fix, so it does not discriminate the repaired behavior. Canonical instance: round-3's R-3 closed-loop scenario reached cooldown 5 and failed the old bytes on an arrival/stale-ripen case instead of the growth-under-chop boundary.

origin.quote: its closed-loop scenario reaches cooldown 5 and fails old bytes for an arrival/stale-ripen case; it does not flip candidate behavior

classes.name: Inserted per-unit logic degrades another own unit's task
classes.description: A wrapper/insertion that reserves, protects, or post-edits on behalf of ONE own unit alters a DIFFERENT own unit's candidate set, selection, or resolved movement so that the second unit's committed task (banking, harvesting, delivery) stalls or livelocks. Canonical instance: the round-4 host panel's terminal failure - the 9f5ef833 BananaBot's protected-mother forbidden-landing re-resolution displaces the FULL second worker's one-step banking landing every other turn, producing a 225-turn (8,4)<->(8,3) MOVE alternation with 2 wood carried and no DROP (I-19/I-20/I-21 violated; D-1 episode), margin +68 -> -93. The class is per-unit-scoped reasoning applied to a shared movement plane: single-unit gates stay green while multi-unit closed-loop behavior livelocks.

origin.quote: a full second worker carrying two wood oscillates between two cells for 225 consecutive turns instead of returning to a door and dropping its cargo

classes.name: Instrument cannot express the behavior class under review
classes.description: The referee/harness/fixture layer is structurally unable to exercise a behavior the invariants govern, so green instruments prove nothing about it. Canonical instance: round-1's static-opponent mini-referee could not test capture (an opponent taking the mother), leaving the full contested response untestable. Detection is a checklist question ('what behavior class can the current instruments NOT express?') because the gap is by definition outside what the instruments measure.

classes.name: Reviewed invariant with no falsifying test
classes.description: An invariant the handoff claims to implement has no test or detector that would fail if it were violated; the all-green ledger is compatible with the violation. Canonical instance: round-1 I-9 one-seed reservation - the committed all-green lifecycle trace itself falsifies I-9 (plants at turns 58 and 61 before banking the surplus) because no check guarded the sequencing rule.

origin.quote: The committed all-green lifecycle trace itself falsifies I-9 ... it has no one-seed reservation

classes.name: Green hand-constructed suites sample too little of the state space
classes.description: Every committed scenario suite and gate is green, yet the defect lives in a state region no hand-constructed scenario visits: five hand-built suites in a row (rounds 1-5) were green while broader host panels kept finding real defects. Canonical instance: the round-4 host review terminal failure on map seed 9,854,000 seat 0 - a 225-turn full-cargo two-cell oscillation in a choke/articulation-corridor geometry (door routes forced through single cells) that none of the committed trace maps contained; the round-5 diagnosis reproduced it only after purpose-building that geometry class (R5_MAP). Hand-picked geometries systematically miss articulation corridors, seat mirrors, adversarial opponent mixes, and long-horizon multi-unit closed-loop interactions. Detection is mechanized: the fuzz-panel gate (claude_1/pipeline/fuzz_panel.py) runs seeded randomized closed-loop games of candidate AND parent on identical generated maps across declared geometry classes (>= 20% choke corridors, both seats, mixed opponent profiles) and asserts P0-P4 on every candidate game (D-1..D-9 zero episodes, R-5 full-cargo alternation, orchard-eligible dormancy byte-equality vs parent, rolling 60-turn liveness floor).
